data.narrative:
Deep Atomic is a pre-seed stage nuclear energy company founded by William G.J. Theron. The valuation analysis draws from a private frontier-tech comp universe of 6 private and 3 public companies in the nuclear energy sector, including public peers Oklo (OKLO), Nano Nuclear Energy (NNE), and SMR, alongside private comparables such as Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

The peer-median method was not applicable to this analysis. The nuclear energy sector contains only 5 same-sector peers, insufficient to generate a reliable median at the pre-seed stage. Specifically, zero same-stage comparables, one adjacent-stage datapoint, and zero similar-tier valuations exist within the filtered dataset. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias given the capital intensity and technical specificity of nuclear development, rendering cross-sector aggregation methodologically unsound.

As a result, triangulated valuation output could not be derived from the available quantitative comp data. Deep Atomic's valuation therefore remains indeterminate based on this dataset alone. A credible range would require either expansion of pre-seed stage nuclear peers meeting narrow filters, or application of alternative methods such as discounted cash flow analysis tied to development milestones, cost-of-capital benchmarking within frontier energy infrastructure, or bottom-up capital requirement modeling. The principal uncertainty remains the extreme sparsity of institutional pre-seed investment data in specialized nuclear subsectors.
